verdict.meaning: FULL is rejected with high confidence and REJECT is rejected with high confidence. SLICE means only that three candidate pilots deserve measurement; their ROI is not yet established and none is approved for integration.

latest_commit_at_capture.message: Merge pull request #2519 from deepseek-harness/feat/npm-public; release and publish the dsh family publicly

history.note: The repository object was only about four days old at capture, while its imported/reachable commit history began about 64 days earlier. GitHub weekly statistics and commit-list pagination have different aggregation semantics and are not expected to sum identically.

npm.assessment: All public versions are release candidates. The source declares a Node requirement, but the published manifest does not enforce it.

dsh_vendor_snapshot.assessment: DSH is built on a materially modified vendored/rescoped Cordis, not on a pristine drop-in upstream dependency.

architecture.invariant: Model-visible means logged: every input reaching a model request must be reconstructable from the append-only session log.
architecture.assessment: The plugin architecture is real and pervasive. The claim of 'no privileged core' is an abstraction claim, not a small-system claim: the published Web composition has 129 rows across a 248-manifest, roughly 260k production-TypeScript codebase.

auth_assessment: Most primary routes require API keys.
Bedrock, Vertex and Azure can use their provider-native ambient credential chains.
A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint can point at a local model server; DSH does not bundle or manage a local model runtime.
The DSH pi-ai adapter has no consumer OAuth login/token-store flow for openai-codex; without a configured profile it suppresses that route as unconfigured.

The bundled pi-ai catalog does include subscription-oriented protocols such as GitHub Copilot OAuth and Kimi Code subscription, plus token-plan products. The DSH adapter does not inject pi-ai's OAuth credential store or run an interactive login, so these are catalog capabilities rather than a demonstrated DSH login path; a manually supplied token/key may still configure a route.
No persistent primary-model route using a Claude.ai, ChatGPT or DeepSeek consumer subscription was found.

product_subagents.assessment: The packages are real and can indirectly use consumer subscriptions through separately installed native CLIs. The out-of-box claim is overstated for the published default, and the wrappers are one-shot bridges rather than Orchestra-equivalent persistent workers.

schedule.cold_session_behavior: overdue reminders are processed only after resume

mcp.security_note: External MCP commands are trusted host processes outside the agent file sandbox.

persistence_memory_and_orchestration.subagent_core: DSH also has native in-process one-shot and continuable child agents with durable descriptors, depth controls, follow-ups, interrupt authority and Web UI. This is separate from the one-shot Codex/Claude product adapters.

in_process_filesystem_tools.assessment: This shares policy vocabulary with shell confinement but is not the same enforcement boundary.

web.assessment: Treat as a local development UI, not as an Orchestra-like authenticated remote multi-user control plane.

postmortem_counter_evidence.fact: The ACP bridge was completely non-functional in production despite 178 green unit tests and 100% line coverage; two real-loader/topology integration bugs were hidden by hand-mounted tests.

ui.worktree_isolation: deferred in current workflow implementation; not an available DSH execution-isolation mode

smoke.preregistered_success: The named command must emit a usable result and the Web command must return HTTP 200 within 15 minutes, while writing only under the disposable directory.

attempts.observation: npm dependency placement stopped progressing; Node 20 is below the source-declared supported engine
same no-output dependency-placement hang on a supported Node runtime
bounded probe killed after no output; no listener appeared
Exact README inner command in a fresh isolated home; npm installed rc.6, emitted one deprecation warning, then printed the loopback URL. Process group was cleaned and the port closed.

attempts.runtime: same published package through pnpm dlx

smoke.conclusion: The exact README command is reproducible on supported Node 24/npm 11 and reached HTTP 200 in 509 seconds. Earlier unlike pinned/help probes stalled and a 120-second pinned Web probe was inconclusive against its 15-minute criterion; these are mixed cold-install outcomes, not failure of the official quick start or a measured variance distribution. The project-native pnpm route was faster in this run.
